Name: Healing Over Time
Description: Heals X health over Y turns

Name: Lifesteal
Description: Heals X health based on damage dealt

Name: Damage Over Time
Description: Deals X damage over Y turns

Name: Death Ward
Description: Revives target with X% health when they reach 0 health

Name: Shield
Description: Absorbs X attacks or Y turns

Name: Reflection
Description: Reflects X% of incoming damage for Y turns or Z charges

Name: Shield Break
Description: Deals X% bonus damage to enemies with wards active

Name: Critical Resistance
Description: Reduces incoming critical bonus by X%

Name: Resistance
Description: Increases resistance to the specified damage type by X%

Name: Reactive Healing
Description: Heals target for X health when hit for Y turns or Z charges

Name: Thorns
Description: Deals X damage to attackers when hit for Y turns or Z charges

Name: Attribute Boost
Description: Increases the specified attribute by X%

Name: Taunt
Description: Forces enemies to target this character

Name: Provoke
Description: Forces target to use basic attacks against the caster

Name: Damage Reduction
Description: Decreases base skill damage by X%

Name: Weaken Resistance
Description: Decreases resistance to the specified damage type by X%

Name: Attribute Reduction
Description: Decreases the specified attribute by X%

Name: Steal Buff
Description: Removes a buff from target and transfers it to caster

Name: Ally Assist
Description: Causes an ally to use their basic attack against target
